products.name: Classic Datil Hot Sauce
products.shortDescription: The datil pepper, straight up — fruity, bright, and genuinely hot. No smoke, nothing extra. Just the sauce doing its thing on your eggs, your tacos, your everything.
products.story: This is the datil in its most direct form. No smoke — just the pepper, vinegar, garlic, and a touch of salt, and a couple of other magic ingredients, balanced until it's exactly right.
products.pairings: Eggs, tacos, grilled chicken, rice bowls, burgers, roasted vegetables.
products.ingredients: Datil pepper mash, white vinegar, bell pepper, water, lime juice, lemon juice, cider vinegar, carrots, onion, tequila, tomato paste, honey, garlic, black garlic, salt, paprika, xanthan gum.

products.name: Smoked Datil Hot Sauce
products.shortDescription: Datil peppers over applewood before the sauce is ever made — smoke woven in from the start, not layered on top. Fruity heat with real depth. This is the one for anything off the grill.
products.story: Before these peppers ever see a pot, they spend hours over applewood. The smoke gets into the fruit of the pepper, not just the skin — so when the sauce comes together, you're not tasting smoke added after the fact. You're tasting it woven in.
products.pairings: Brisket, pulled pork, chili, burgers, smoked wings, grilled vegetables.
products.ingredients: Smoked datil pepper mash, white vinegar, bell pepper, water, lime juice, lemon juice, cider vinegar, carrots, onion, tequila, tomato paste, honey, garlic, black garlic, salt, paprika, xanthan gum.
